I've had a good look and a poke around, and this is exactly what we agreed on. Everything I care about is there and behaving the way I pictured:

- Saving a link pulls in details and keeps my edits, with a fallback icon when there isn't one.
- Saving a link I already have — even with different capitalization or a trailing `#` bit — takes me back to the existing one instead of making a second copy. That was important to me and it works.
- Read-later, archive, and restore are all present, and new items start unread.
- Search handles tag shorthand and exact phrases, and shows me how it read my query.
- Saved searches, bulk selection, rich formatted notes, and my display preferences are all in place.
- I can export my collection to a normal browser bookmarks file (tags and all) and import one back in.

It also feels calm and clear to use, which I appreciate. I'm happy with it — this is what I wanted. Accepted.

I do have a couple of ideas for down the road (like keeping a saved copy of a page in case it disappears), but those are new wishes for a later round, not anything missing from what we agreed. Thank you for the careful work.
